name: War of Mine : Ghost
source: In this two parts' kinetic visual novel, you’ll experience the story through multiple characters' perspectives, each serving as an interlude and introduction to the world of W.O.M (War Of Mine). This pivotal event sets the stage for an upcoming game, where you’ll take on the role of a main male protagonist navigating the same world, three years after this pivotal event.​
